{{Top|leg}}
'''Plaster''' was a material used for construction. Buildings on [[Circumtore/Legends|Circumtore]] around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] were known to feature plaster in their make-up,<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref> and several structures throughout [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]<ref name="ImpCom501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> made use of plaster, including the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]].<ref name="TLJ">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>
